scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: #4270 (X23): the caller passed 20 bytes, fewer than WS-CA-HEADER-LEN (28): IF EIBCALEN IS LESS THAN WS-CA-HEADER-LEN (line 143) is true -- '98', RETURN; no DELETE, no LINK. The COMMAREA it leaves is compared over its 20 bytes

scenarios.name: short-commarea-delete-fails
scenarios.why: #4270 (X23): 40 bytes (the 28-byte header passed): DELETE-POLICY-DB2-INFO's DELETE (line 189) fails -904: '90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG, then IF EIBCALEN < 91 is true -- DFHCOMMAREA(1:40) into CA-DATA and the second LINK, whose 104-byte WRITEQ is written padded (X6, ASSUMED): the whole task is compared

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgdpdb01: CUSTOMER, POLICY and the ENDOWMENT / HOUSE / MOTOR / COMMERCIAL tables are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (the same generate block as genapp-lgupdb01-generated: identity policy numbers 1000001..1000012 (the requests carry them), FKs POLICY->CUSTOMER and type->POLICY, NULLs and boundary values), not GenApp's INSERTs. The scenarios are written against those seed 4507 rows. Covered: a DELETE FROM POLICY of each type (the cascade into ENDOWMENT / HOUSE / MOTOR, and a policy that holds two type rows), the lowest and highest timestamps, a wrong customer and an unknown policy and a repeated delete (+100 -> '90', LGSTSQ), the non-delete request ids ('99'), no / short COMMAREA. ksdspoly.txt (LGDPVS01's KSDSPOLY) holds a record for each generated policy that is deleted. Every table the cascade reaches, CLAIM included, is compared after each task. A change to the generator's draw moves the rows: the E2E test in tests/cobol_mainframe/test_equivalence_db2_rows.py fails the case then. Program, LINKed LGDPVS01 / LGSTSQ and the LGCMAREA COMMAREA as in genapp-lgdpdb01.
